answer: Histories are stored in ivory, checked in island, and prism publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4445 identities would post 1237 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
